pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: Main near-square hip: NE hip line from the NE corner to about (580,507), SE hip to about (640,597); short E-W ridge. South eave at y about 628 west of x=612 and about 605 east of it (notched SE corner, excluded).

pieces.name: nw_upper
pieces.notes: Raised NW hip: own lit west hip-end, dark north face, ridge about y=466 from x 497 to 547, own south eave line at y about 522 over the main roof. Read as 2-story block; could be a same-level front hip.

notes: Axis-aligned hip home. Main hip (E-W ridge, nearly square plan) plus a raised NW hip block with its own eave line. Trace overshoots: west side-yard strip, south patio strip, SE notch; all excluded. Confidence medium-high on regions; level of the NW block is the doubt.
